label: V1 · Checklist
title: Guided checklist rail: one scrolling document with a persistent section checklist, live required-field counts, and a pre-submit review that lists every outstanding item (tax-software pattern)

label: V2 · Steps
title: Chunked steps: a stepper that adds and removes steps as answers change, per-step gating with 'skip for now', and a persistent outstanding-items tray (incident-management pattern)

label: V3 · Ardent Sky
title: Ardent Sky inspired: completion donut, status-filtered section tree with per-branch counts, requirement-source donut, and a sortable open-items table above the form

label: V4 · Owners
title: Ownership model: sections grouped into Yours now / Waiting on others / Done, with assignment, due dates, and a completion bar segmented by owner
